grades: Teens in grades 9 to 12. Kids ages 11 to 13 may apply as library helpers with a parent's approval.
duration: School year positions, plus summer positions that run June to August
name: Teen Volunteer Program (school year and summer)
what_you_do: Help with youth programs and prepare program materials. Write book reviews and make social media posts. In summer, work the Summer Reading Club booth or the Studio maker space. You help patrons with arts, crafts and tech.
who_can_apply: The program is for teens in grades 9 to 12. Kids ages 11 to 13 can apply to serve as library helpers for certain youth programs with parent or guardian approval.
deadline_text: Applications for school year teen volunteers were open when read (October 2026). Summer 2026 applications closed for the season. 2027 summer dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Summer was closed when we checked on 2026-10-10. School year applications are open. Go to the volunteering page. Fill out the volunteer form there. If you have a question, write to teenvolunteers@wilmettelibrary.info.
notes: Summer jobs run June to August. Krista Hutley is the teen librarian. Eti Berland is the school engagement librarian. They are the teen volunteer coordinators. The Studio program has its own info sheet.
